create.name: Rangjung Yeshe Gomde
create.bio:
Rangjung Yeshe Gomde is a Tibetan Buddhist practice and study centre on a hillside above Scharnstein in the Alm valley of Upper Austria. Its founder is Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche, the Nepal-based abbot of Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling monastery in Boudhanath and eldest son of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, who remains its spiritual head; the old farmstead bought in 2004 has since been rebuilt by volunteers into a residential centre with a meditation hall, gardens and a pond. Gomde teaches mainly within the Kagyu and Nyingma lines of the Chokling Tersar, while welcoming study of every Buddhist tradition, and its regular teachers include Lama Thierry, a Swiss practitioner who spent twelve years as a monk, six of them in retreat.

The centre runs weekend and longer residential seminars on a suggested-donation basis, from mind-training and guru yoga weekends to a month-long Ngöndro retreat each January, along with seasonal festivals. A free open meditation is held on Monday evenings, and Lama Thierry guides a weekly tonglen session on Zoom. Visitors can also come for Dharma stays, joining the daily practice and helping in the house and garden. Talks, interviews and episodes of the Kind Heartfulness podcast, hosted by the author Erric Solomon, appear on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Chöd & vier Schlüssel zur Vertiefung der Praxis
courses.description: A weekend retreat on the Chöd practice of Machik Labdrön, in which Lama Thierry guides meditations on four foundations of practice: renunciation, compassion, devotion and view. Taught in German and English; refuge and bodhisattva vows are prerequisites.
courses.price: Empfohlene Spende: 240 €, einschließlich Unterkunft und Verpflegung

courses.title: Einmonatige Ngöndro-Praxis-Klausur 2027
courses.description: A month-long group retreat on the preliminary practices (Ngöndro) of the Vajrayana path, for intermediate and advanced practitioners, with contributions set per day according to room type.

courses.title: Dharma Aufenthalte
courses.description: Stays of a few days or weeks at the centre, joining the morning and afternoon group practice, the Monday meditation and spontaneous teachings, with the option of meeting Lama Thierry about one's practice and helping with light work.
courses.price: Zur Deckung der Fixkosten wäre ein Beitrag von 75 Euro pro Tag hilfreich.

free_resources.title: Tonglen Dienstag mit Lama Thierry
free_resources.description: A free weekly online session on Zoom every Tuesday evening, in which Lama Thierry guides tonglen practice with explanations; newcomers are asked to watch two introductory videos first.

free_resources.title: Kind Heartfulness Podcast
free_resources.description: A podcast from the centre, hosted by Erric Solomon, with conversations with Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche and other Buddhist teachers, scholars and meditators.
